The proposed Appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the insurer challenging the Award dated 06.10.2023, passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/IInd Additional District Judge, Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar in Motor Accident Claim Petition No.155 of 2018, by which, the learned Judge has awarded a sum of Rs.11,91,700/- (Rupees Eleven Lakh Ninety One Thousand Seven Hundred) as compensation along with an interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till its actual payment.
2. Heard Mr. Bharat Tewari, learned counsel for appellant.
3.

sentences.text: Heard on the Stay Application (IA No.01 of 2023).
8. Mr. Bharat Tewari, Advocate, has sought three weeks' time from today to deposit Rs.12,00,000/-(Rupees Twelve Lakh) with the Tribunal concerned.
9. The Insurance Company is granted one week's time to deposit the said amount before the Tribunal concerned.
10. Subject to depositing of Rs.12,00,000/-(Rupees Twelve Lakh), within a week from today, the effect and operation of the impugned Award dated 06.10.2023 are stayed till the next date of listing.
11. Stay Application No.01 of 2023 stands disposed of accordingly.
